name: Google Docs Settings
description: Company-wide Google Drive/Docs integration settings for the ERP -> Google Docs engine. The service-account key is stored as an encrypted Password field and is never exposed to the client.

fields.label: Service Account JSON Key
fields.description: Paste the full JSON key of a Google Workspace service account. Stored encrypted; never sent to the browser.

fields.label: Impersonate User (Domain-Wide Delegation)
fields.description: Optional Workspace user to act as, e.g. docs@yourcompany.com. Required unless you generate into a Shared Drive, because a service account has no personal Drive quota.

fields.options: The service account must have Drive + Docs APIs enabled. For delegation, a Workspace admin authorises the client ID for scopes documents and drive. See the module README for the full setup.

fields.label: Default Drive Folder ID
fields.description: Fallback folder for generated docs when a template does not set its own. Take it from the folder URL: drive.google.com/drive/folders/<THIS_ID>.

fields.label: Shared Drive ID
fields.description: Optional. Set if the folder lives in a Shared Drive.

fields.label: Default Sharing Mode
fields.options:
Inherit Folder
Private
Company (Domain)
Specific Emails
Anyone With Link
fields.description: Applied when a template does not override it. Never defaults to public.
